answer: Each identity must hold one signal feed subscription, with a pigment-marked receipt bound to its key and a 60-credit bond locked. An auditor checks the registry, one receipt per key, and recomputes the delta between signal and claimed output; mismatch burns the bond. The k-th fake still needs its own 35-credit subscription plus a fresh 60-credit lock, one receipt per key. One thousand fakes lock 60,000 credits and pay 35,000 per epoch. A rented-feed ring fails: a borrowed receipt carries another key. An honest agent pays 60 once and 35 for its own feed, bond returned after a clean epoch.
